name: Sewing
description: Sewing word search puzzles gather needle-and-stitch English for adults and seniors — seam, hem, thread, bobbin, pattern and quiet craft-room words — without sewing-machine brands or licensed characters. Every grid is free online with no download, no account and no timer. Choose easy across-and-down warm-ups, medium grids with diagonals, hard puzzles in all eight directions, or large print with bigger letters on a smaller board. The list stays practical and domestic: cotton, linen, darts, pleats, zippers and mend-day vocabulary many home sewists already know. This hub pairs well with Knitting, Quilting and Calligraphy when you want a longer craft afternoon. Prefer bigger type? Start with large print. New solvers can read how to play, then pick a difficulty as calm as a pressed seam.
